parentGoal: Security fixes + backend tech debt batch

lanes.scope: Fix Strava webhook to reject unauthenticated forged activity events
lanes.changes: Added synchronous owner_id verification via runnerRepository.findByStravaAthleteId(). Forged events with unknown owner_ids now return 403 UNKNOWN_OWNER instead of 200 EVENT_RECEIVED.

lanes.scope: Fix password reset endpoint to prevent user enumeration
lanes.changes: Added 150ms timing normalization delay on not-found path in requestPasswordReset() to mask sendResetLink() latency. Response body was already identical for all paths.

lanes.scope: Batch backend tech debt: ShoeImageController split
lanes.changes: Extracted callGemini/callClaude AI provider methods and SHOE_PROMPT constant into new AiShoeScanService. Controller reduced from 652 to ~555 lines. Clean separation of HTTP concerns vs AI provider communication.
lanes.mergeNotes: New service file created. Controller constructor signature changed (added AiShoeScanService param) but Spring auto-wires it. No other files affected.

summary: 3 lanes completed cleanly. Lane 1 (Strava webhook auth) + Lane 2 (password reset timing) address the 2 active security tasks. Lane 3 extracted AiShoeScanService from ShoeImageController reducing file size by ~100 lines. Pre-existing compile error in AdminBackgroundJobService (Jackson TypeFactory.defaultInstance()) is unrelated to these changes.
